target_customer: Real estate agents, home sellers and buyers in Peru, Colombia and Ecuador
problem: Buying, selling and renting property in Latin America is slow and fragmented; GoJom combines agent tools, instant purchase offers and mortgage loans.
business_model: Real estate marketplace and brokerage: commission sharing between agents, instant buying (iBuy) and loans against property

founders.name: Andres Gonzalez-Olaechea
founders.background_notes: YC page says investment banker and asset manager in the US and Latin America; firms and schools not named. Role label CEO is not stated in the sources I opened, one search summary calls him CTO, which conflicts.

founders.name: Horacio Faudella
previous_startups: AdondeVivir.com (Peruvian real estate portal, exit in Peru per YC page)
founders.background_notes: Serial digital entrepreneur since 1997 per YC page.

founders.name: William Wong Garay
founders.background_notes: YC page calls him a self taught software engineer with 20+ years of experience; no formal education listed.

competitors.name: AdondeVivir and Urbania (Navent)
competitors.what: Long established online property listing portals in Peru, owned by Navent
competitors.traction_then: Described as the long used portals for browsing Peruvian listings
competitors.funding_then: Part of Navent group; amount not stated

competitors.name: Aptuno
competitors.what: Latin American proptech that raised money in the same month as GoJom
competitors.funding_then: Raised around Dec 2021 per Bloomberg Linea headline; amount not read

technical_complexity.rationale: Marketplace plus automated valuation and agent software; mostly standard engineering but with real estate transaction and lending operations.

defensibility.rationale: Founders already built and exited a Peruvian property portal, giving agent relationships; listings portals are still copyable.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not established from sources; GoJom expanded into Colombia in 2021 and Ecuador in Feb 2022.

market_need_then: Fragmented Latin American real estate markets; Ecuador alone described as having a deficit of 2.7 million housing units (Bloomberg Linea, Feb 2022). Proptech funding in the region was active in late 2021.

branding.domain_note: gojom.com now redirects to a domain sales page (HugeDomains), so the exact .com is parked or lost; the company appears to use gojom.co per search results.

brand_strength.rationale: Regional press (Forbes Peru, Forbes Colombia, Gestion, Bloomberg Linea) covered the company, but no coverage of the brand itself and the main .com domain is parked.

outcome_analysis: GoJom raised 1M USD in November 2021 and entered Colombia and Ecuador, and the YC page shows 140 people and an Active status. Founders with a prior Peruvian property portal exit fit the market. Later funding is unclear because databases conflict, and no post batch troubles surfaced in searches.
notes: The 1M USD round of Nov 2021 is reported by Forbes Peru, Gestion and Valora Analitik (lead named as Technopeak plus bankers); Bloomberg Linea attributes it to Dalus Capital and Kayyak Ventures, a conflict. CB Insights says about 6M USD total raised and VCBacked shows a 2023 date, both aggregator only and unverified. The round precedes the YC batch by under 2 months so stage is recorded as other (outlets say pre Series A). Competitor list was inferred from press naming Navent portals as the incumbent portals; no source named them as GoJom rivals directly. Outcome search found no layoffs or shutdown.
